metadata.description: Claude Code skills from Nat20 InfoSec for defensive security work: malware triage, OSINT recon, and threat-intel analysis.

plugins.name: malware-triage
plugins.description: Safe, static-only first-look triage of a suspicious file - hashing, string extraction, header inspection - turned into a structured triage brief with a draft IOC list. Never executes or detonates the file. Includes a Vagrant lab scaffold for the dynamic-analysis follow-up.

plugins.name: osint-recon
plugins.description: Passive, public-source security recon on a vendor, product, domain, or your org's own footprint. Produces a graded OSINT brief.

plugins.name: threat-intel
plugins.description: Structured threat intelligence analysis from a URL, article, CVE, malware family, campaign, or APT reference - architecture, IOCs, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and an organizational relevance assessment.

plugins.name: owasp-security
plugins.description: Third-party, MIT-licensed (c) Agam More: security review and secure-coding skill covering OWASP Top 10:2025, ASVS 5.0, LLM Top 10 (2026) and Agentic Top 10 (2026). Referenced from upstream, not copied; pinned to a reviewed commit.
